properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Real digest/derived-value comparisons in the exchange's security-critical path (signature-recovered maker address check; Merkle root equality). On the EVM these run as single constant-time 32-byte EQ operations over public calldata with identical cost on every node, so the Web2 timing-side-channel rationale does not apply — but the comparison locations themselves are genuine protocol code worth recording.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: WyvernToken test fixture: boundedRandom picks random UTXO indices and amounts (randomUTXO = utxoSet[boundedRandom(...)]) to exercise redeemUTXO edge cases against the Truffle/testrpc chain. Test-data generation only — no protocol security decision draws entropy from it; testrpc account keys are managed by the node. Real weak PRNG, kept as a posture record with the honest scope.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Wyvern NFT exchange protocol: off-chain orders are authenticated by ECDSA (secp256k1) via the EVM ecrecover precompile — ExchangeCore.validateOrder (ecrecover(hash, sig.v, sig.r, sig.s) == order.maker) for order matching/cancellation, and UTXORedeemableToken verifies Bitcoin-style ECDSA signatures with uncompressed pubkeys (ecdsaVerify → validateSignature, pubkey→Ethereum-address via keccak256) to port Bitcoin UTXOs into tokens. Changeable here in principle, but secp256k1/ecrecover is an EVM pre

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Vendored doxity (Solidity doc generator, @digix/doxity 0.5.2, pulled into this repo) lockfile entry. tweetnacl 0.14.5 is the canonical JS implementation of Ed25519/X25519/XSalsa20-Poly1305/SHA-512. Doc toolchain only — never compiled into or reachable from the deployed exchange contracts; changeable here by regenerating docs with a modern toolchain. Dep declaration is the dependency inventory: the build ships these algorithms whether or not doxity's own code calls them directly.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Wyvern exchange protocol hashing: keccak256 (Ethereum's pre-FIPS-202 SHA-3 — 0x01 padding, NOT the standardized SHA3-256) is the platform hash. Used for: order hashing (ExchangeCore.hashOrder assembly at ExchangeCore.sol:286 + EIP-191 '\x19Ethereum Signed Message:\n32' prefix at :301), Merkle proof verification (OpenZeppelin MerkleProof in the UTXO redemption path — artifact build/contracts/MerkleProof.json), DAO proposal hashing (DelegatedShareholderAssociation.sol:247,277,356), and pubkey→addr

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Doc-toolchain dependency of the vendored doxity generator; not part of the exchange protocol. crypto-js 3.1.8 is an old (2015-era) release of a now-deprecated library; if it were ever invoked, its defaults (EvpKDF with a single MD5 iteration for key derivation) would matter more than AES itself. Recorded as dependency inventory; no call site found in doxity's own source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Doc-toolchain dependency (crypto-browserify polyfill family) of the vendored doxity generator. PBKDF2's quantum exposure runs through its HMAC hash (Grover square-root) and iteration count; the iteration count is not visible at a lockfile declaration, only at call sites — none exist in doxity's own source. Not part of the deployed protocol.

properties.name: pqs:context

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Same underlying package as the Ed25519 algorithm row (ALG-683d5cd2) — this row records the library itself, that row one algorithm it provides. tweetnacl ships Ed25519 signatures, X25519 key agreement, XSalsa20-Poly1305 authenticated encryption and SHA-512 — all classical, all Shor/Grover-relevant. Doc toolchain only; no call site in doxity's own source (transitive dep); the lockfile pin is what the build ships.

properties.name: pqs:context

No direct call site in doxity's own source; declaration recorded.
